systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous High-Pressure Supercritical CO2 Antisolvent Precipitation & Electrostatic Micro-Encapsulation (SAS-EME) Industrial Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Non-Thermal Supercritical Antisolvent Electrostatic Precipitation & Nano-Encapsulation Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / USP <467> Residual Solvents / USP <711> Dissolution / 3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 & 08-17 / EHEDG Type EL Class I CIP / ASME Section VIII Div 1 & ASME B31.3 High-Pressure Process Piping)
systemArchitectures.technology: High-Voltage Coaxial Electrostatic Micro-Capillary Emitter (15 – 45 kV Taylor Cone Atomization) coupled with Dense-Phase Supercritical CO2 Antisolvent Extraction Chamber (scCO2, P = 90 – 160 bar, T = 35 – 42°C, antisolvent-to-solvent mass ratio R = 15 – 65) for ultra-fast solvent extraction (<15 ms), monodisperse sub-micron encapsulates (d = 80 – 250 nm, PDI < 0.045), zero thermal degradation, and residual solvent < 1.0 ppm without chlorinated solvents
systemArchitectures.cipSanitizationRating: 100% Resistant to 2.0% NaOH at 80°C, 1.5% PAA at 50°C, Automated Clean-in-Place (CIP) & Supercritical CO2 Sterile Depressurization Conformance

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Lipophilic Curcuminoid Crystalline Core-Shell Nanospheres (Curcuma longa)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Standardized 95% total curcuminoid extract co-dissolved with enteric polymethacrylate (Eudragit L100) or PLGA in food-grade ethanol.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Curcuminoids (95% purity: Curcumin, DMC, BDMC) in Food-Grade Anhydrous Ethanol (4.5% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: Eudragit L100 (2.5% w/v) + Phosphatidylcholine (0.4% w/v) Carrier Matrix
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Hot Spray Drying (170°C inlet, >45% curcumin thermal degradation, erratic particle size >25 µm, dissolution <1.5%)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: USP Curcumin Monograph, USP <467> Class 3 Solvents, FDA 21 CFR § 73.600 & EFSA Novel Food

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Trans-Resveratrol Polyphenol Ultra-Fine Crystalline Complex (Polygonum cuspidatum)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: High-purity trans-resveratrol co-precipitated with hydroxypropyl methylcellulose (HPMC) to suppress trans-to-cis photo-isomerization and achieve instant dissolution.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Trans-Resveratrol (98% purity) in Ethyl Acetate / Ethanol Binary Blend (3.8% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: HPMC E5 Grade (2.0% w/v) + Poloxamer 188 (0.3% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Rotary Evaporative Crystallization (Needle-like macro-crystals >100 µm, severe agglomeration, poor dissolution <3.2%)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: USP <711> Dissolution, FDA GRAS Notice GRN 000512 & EFSA Resveratrol Safety Opinion

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Quercetin Dihydrate Flavonoid Nanoparticles in PVP Matrix (Sophora japonica)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Hydrophobic flavonol quercetin micronized into stable amorphous solid dispersion inside polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP K30) shell.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Quercetin Dihydrate (96% purity) in Anhydrous Ethanol (4.0% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: Polyvinylpyrrolidone PVP K30 (3.0% w/v) + Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate (0.15% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: High-Pressure Jet Milling (Tribological friction heating >75°C, thermal oxidation of quercetin B-ring catechol, particle damage)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS Notice GRN 000341, USP <467> Class 3 & European Pharmacopoeia (Ph. Eur.)

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Broad-Spectrum Cannabidiol (CBD) Nanospheres in Zein Corn Protein
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Phytocannabinoid isolate encapsulated in renewable corn zein biopolymer matrix for high chemical stability and odorless water-dispersibility.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Natural Broad-Spectrum CBD (99.2% purity) in Food-Grade 90% Ethanol (5.0% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: Refined Corn Zein Protein (3.5% w/v) + Soy Lecithin Surfactant (0.5% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: High-Shear Rotor-Stator Emulsification (Incomplete encapsulation, cannabinoid thermal oxidation, rancid odor development)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: WHO Expert Committee on Drug Dependence (ECDD), FDA cGMP 21 CFR § 111 & EFSA Novel Food Dossier

bioactivePayloadFormulations.name: Coenzyme Q10 (Ubiquinone) Crystalline Nanospheres in Phospholipid-PEG Matrix
bioactivePayloadFormulations.payloadDescription: Highly hydrophobic, low-melting (48°C) quinone antioxidant micro-encapsulated without melting or phase segregation.
bioactivePayloadFormulations.coreComposition: Coenzyme Q10 (99.5% purity) in Ethyl Acetate / Acetone Blend (4.2% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.shellPolymerSystem: Hydrogenated Soy Phosphatidylcholine (2.2% w/v) + D-α-Tocopheryl Polyethylene Glycol Succinate (TPGS, 0.6% w/v)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.degradingAlternative: Melt Solidification / Thermal Spray Congealing (Phase separation, oxidation of benzoquinone ring, loss of antioxidant potency)
bioactivePayloadFormulations.regulatoryStandard: USP Coenzyme Q10 Monograph, FDA 21 CFR § 101 Dietary Supplements & USP <711>
